records.text: Not bad for a first try! Watch the beat line and keep your taps steady.
records.speaker: Ryan
records.instruct: Speak in natural American English as a friendly, confident male game guide. Use clear conversational phrasing and a comfortable, lively pace. Keep the same voice throughout. Speak only the supplied words. Explain clearly and naturally, like helping a friend. Clearly articulate the final s in the plural word taps, with a very short pause before steady.
